caseName: United States v. First City National Bank of Houston
caseNameFull: United States v. First City National Bank of Houston
attorneys: Eugene J. Metzger for Comptroller of the Currency on the motion.

opinions.text:
Appeal from D. C. S. D. Tex. (Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 1023.) Motion of appellees for additional time for oral argument granted and thirty additional minutes allotted to each side.

Mr. Justice Clark took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
